“霖霖，你认识刘济民同志？”
医学院女生宿舍内，朱霖正坐在床上看杂志，舍友楚红突然凑过来问道。
朱霖正看得入神，被楚红的举动吓了一跳，根本没听清楚红说的是什么：“你说什么？”
“我说，你跟刘济民同志很熟？”楚红笑吟吟地盯着朱霖的眼睛，人在慌乱的时候是最容易露出马脚的。
果然，朱霖的眼神闪过一丝慌乱，用手挑起鬓角的头发，掩饰道：“没有啊，就上次在读书会上见过。”
楚红踮起脚，双手扒在床沿上，身体用力前倾，近距离用眼睛上下打量着朱霖：“那你脸红什么？”
“红了吗？”朱霖慌忙用手摸了摸脸颊，好像是有点烫。楚红不说还好，这下更红了。
“你不对劲！”楚红将手中洗好的苹果递给了朱霖，“小同志，你很不对劲！”
“哎呀，我看是你不对劲。”朱霖接过苹果咬了一口，想要躲过楚红的追问。
“切！”楚红猛咬了一口苹果：“上次在西山大队挖排水沟，你还送了一瓶水果罐头给刘济民同志。”
“嗐，刚好多了一瓶。”
朱霖躺到床上想要背过身去，又被楚红上下其手抓痒给拉了起来：“认识就认识，刘济民同志挺和气的，还想让你介绍认识一下。上次读书会，连个脸熟都没混上。”
“相处起来怪怪的。”朱霖想到上次北影厂，跟刘济民的对话，白皙的脸庞上泛起浅浅的酒窝。
“你怎么知道？哎呦喂，你这是什么表情？”楚红像是发现了新大陆，大叫道。
“我就是想起读书会的事儿了！”
另一个室友站了起来：“你们猜，刘济民同志是昙花一现，还是？”
“我听说，很多杂志上的作家，都是偶尔上稿一篇，后来基本上就上不了稿了。”
朱霖立即反驳道：“他不一样，刘济民同志才华横溢，你们不懂。”
楚红看到反应如此激烈的朱霖，嘿嘿一笑，转身插着兜回到了自己的床铺，做派跟大姐大一般：“好了，别聊了，睡觉睡觉。”
朱霖知道自己反应有点激烈，想要解释，但楚红已经转身回到了自己的床铺。
翌日早上，食堂吃饭的时候，刘济民碰见了朱霖，冲对方微微点头，朱霖颔首笑着回应。

"Linlin, do you know Comrade Liu Jimin?"
In the female dormitory of the medical school, Zhu Lin was sitting on the bed reading a magazine when her roommate Chu Hong suddenly came over and asked.
Zhu Lin was watching intently and was startled by Chu Hong's actions. He didn't hear clearly what Hong said: "What did you say?"
"I said, are you familiar with Comrade Liu Jimin?" Chu Hong stared into Zhu Lin's eyes with a smile. People are most likely to reveal their flaws when they are in a panic.
Sure enough, Zhu Lin's eyes flashed with panic. He lifted up his hair at the temples with his hands and concealed it: "No, I just saw him at the reading meeting last time."
Chu Hong stood on tiptoes, put her hands on the edge of the bed, leaned forward hard, and looked Zhu Lin up and down with her eyes from a close distance: "Then why are you blushing?"
"Is it red?" Zhu Lin hurriedly touched his cheek with his hand, it seemed a little hot. It's okay if Chu Hong doesn't say it, but she's even redder now.
"There's something wrong with you!" Chu Hong handed the washed apple to Zhu Lin, "Little comrade, something is very wrong with you!"
"Oh, I think something is wrong with you." Zhu Lin took the apple and took a bite, trying to avoid Chu Hong's questioning.
"Tch!" Chu Hong took a bite of the apple: "Last time when we were digging drainage ditches in the Xishan Brigade, you also gave Comrade Liu Jimin a bottle of canned fruit."
"Hey, there's just one more bottle."
Zhu Lin lay on the bed and wanted to turn his back, but was pulled up by Chu Hong's hands scratching him: "I know you, Comrade Liu Jimin is very kind, and I want you to introduce me to him. Last time at the reading group, I didn't even get to know anyone."
"It's weird to get along with each other." Zhu Lin thought of the conversation he had with Liu Jimin at the Beijing Film Studio last time, and a slight dimple appeared on his fair face.
"How do you know? Hey, what's your expression?" Chu Hong shouted as if she had discovered a new world.
"I just remembered the book club!"
Another roommate stood up: "Do you think Comrade Liu Jimin is a flash in the pan, or is he?"
"I've heard that many writers in magazines occasionally submit a manuscript, but then basically no longer get it published."
Zhu Lin immediately retorted: "He is different. Comrade Liu Jimin is talented, you don't understand."
Seeing Zhu Lin reacting so fiercely, Chu Hong smiled, turned around and returned to her bed with her pockets in her pockets, acting like an elder sister: "Okay, stop talking, go to sleep."
Zhu Lin knew that his reaction was a bit violent and wanted to explain, but Chu Hong had already turned around and returned to his bed.
The next morning, while eating in the cafeteria, Liu Jimin met Zhu Lin and nodded slightly to him. Zhu Lin responded with a nod and a smile.
